paragraphs: Bond Sports sells the software that a sports facility runs its business on. It aims at operators of complex multi-sport venues and ice rinks rather than youth clubs alone.

Scheduling, registration, memberships and payments sit on one data model, so availability, billing and reporting stay in sync when something moves. Rentals, events and leagues share a single calendar with recurring bookings, conflict checks and invoicing. Point of sale covers terminals, concessions, merchandise and pro shop sales. Failed membership charges and missing cards are flagged and retried automatically.

Facility types listed include aquatics, fitness, dance, youth sports, parks and recreation departments and universities. Named users quoted on the site include the general manager of Chelsea Piers Sky Rink. The company says customers process more than $250M in registrations a year through the platform. Most facilities go live in three to four weeks. Data migration, configuration and staff training are handled by Bond during the switch.

quote.text: One system instead of five tools
